title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
authors_zh: Timo Kaufmann, Paul Weng, Viktor Bengs, Eyke Hüllermeier
paper_type_zh: 跨领域 RLHF 综述与审计框架
best_for_zh: 适合在阅读或设计具体 RLHF 系统前定位反馈、reward model 和策略假设的研究者。
one_line: This survey separates RLHF into feedback acquisition, reward learning, and policy learning across control, robotics, and LLMs.
这篇综述把跨控制、机器人和 LLM 的 RLHF 拆成反馈采集、奖励学习与策略学习三阶段。
why: It reveals which data and assumptions support each stage instead of treating RLHF as one opaque operation.
inclusion_reason: A formal map of RLHF from preference collection through reward learning and policy optimization.

title: Problem
问题
html:
“RLHF” often collapses several different decisions into one label: which behavior is queried, how a human expresses feedback, how that feedback becomes a reward estimate, and how a policy consumes the estimate. Without separating these objects, a policy result can be mistaken for evidence that the preference data or reward model is reliable.

This survey builds a cross-domain map of RLHF, with its most detailed coverage in control and robotics and a dedicated treatment of language-model fine-tuning. It decomposes the field into feedback acquisition, reward learning, and policy learning, then catalogs assumptions, algorithms, applications, datasets, and open problems at each stage.

L4 facts: primary sources https://openreview.net/forum?id=f7OkIurx4b and https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.14925; TMLR 2025; boundary: survey and audit framework, not a new preference dataset or algorithm; atlas value: routes feedback records to reward and policy consumers; coverage: control, robotics, LLMs, image/music generation, and games.

“RLHF”常把多个不同决定压缩成一个标签：查询什么行为、人类如何表达反馈、反馈怎样变成奖励估计，以及策略如何使用这个估计。如果不区分这些对象，策略结果就容易被误当成偏好数据或 reward model 可靠的证据。

这篇综述建立了一张跨领域 RLHF 地图，其中对控制与机器人最为详细，并单独讨论语言模型微调。它把领域拆成反馈采集、奖励学习和策略学习，再逐阶段整理假设、算法、应用、数据集与开放问题。

L4 事实：主要来源为 https://openreview.net/forum?id=f7OkIurx4b 和 https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.14925；TMLR 2025；边界是综述与审计框架，而非新偏好数据集或算法；图谱价值是把反馈记录连接到奖励与策略消费者；覆盖控制、机器人、LLM、图像与音乐生成以及游戏。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The survey's contribution is a formal decomposition from feedback acquisition to reward learning to policy learning. It distinguishes demonstrations, corrections, comparisons, rankings, ratings, critiques, and other feedback forms; asks how queries and annotators are selected; then tracks how learned reward signals interact with policy optimization, distribution shift, and reward exploitation. Compared with LLM-only RLHF overviews, it imports a longer control/robotics lineage and makes the feedback object's semantics explicit, which is why it functions as a foundations card.

Google Scholar citations: 513（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=A+Survey+of+Reinforcement+Learning+from+Human+Feedback&author=Timo+Kaufmann&hl=en）

Open dataset: no. The survey does not release a new dataset; Section 8.4 catalogs existing RLHF datasets across domains. Their names, locations, sizes, record forms, licenses, and intended uses remain properties of the cited primary releases and must be checked there rather than inferred from this survey.

这篇综述的核心贡献是从反馈采集到奖励学习再到策略学习的形式化分解。它区分示范、纠正、比较、排序、评分、批评等反馈形式，讨论如何选择查询和标注者，再追踪学习到的奖励信号如何与策略优化、分布偏移和奖励利用相互作用。与只讨论 LLM 的 RLHF 概览相比，它引入了更长期的控制与机器人研究脉络，并明确反馈对象的语义，因此适合作为基础类 Card。

Google Scholar 引用数：513（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=A+Survey+of+Reinforcement+Learning+from+Human+Feedback&author=Timo+Kaufmann&hl=en）

开源数据：没有。综述没有发布新数据集；第 8.4 节整理了不同领域已有的 RLHF 数据集。它们的名称、位置、规模、记录形式、许可证和用途属于各自主论文与发布物，不能从本综述推断。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Set the boundary. Input: literature described as preference-based RL, semi-supervised RL, or RLHF. Operation: define RLHF as learning a reward or policy from indirect human feedback rather than a manually specified scalar reward. Output: an inclusion scope spanning control and language models. Check: keep direct demonstrations and offline initialization distinct when they are not the main feedback loop.
  1. Classify feedback acquisition. Input: queries, behavior samples, annotators, and interfaces. Operation: organize demonstrations, interventions, corrections, comparisons, rankings, ratings, critiques, and language feedback by what the human observes and returns. Output: a feedback-record taxonomy. Check: record annotator population, query policy, granularity, noise, and cost.
  1. Classify reward learning. Input: feedback records. Operation: compare preference models, reward functions, Bayesian and ensemble treatments, active query selection, and ways to handle uncertainty. Output: a learned signal and its assumptions. Check: test held-out preference prediction, calibration, identifiability, and distribution shift.
  1. Classify policy learning. Input: learned reward or direct preference signal and policy rollouts. Operation: survey online/offline RL, regularization, model-based variants, and LLM-specific objectives. Output: an optimized policy. Check: separate reward fit from policy behavior and test reward hacking or overoptimization.
  1. Route evidence and risks. Input: applications, benchmarks, datasets, and reported failures. Operation: map each claim back to its feedback, reward, policy, and evaluation objects. Output: a reusable audit checklist and open-problem map. Check: verify implementation-specific details in the cited primary source.

1. 确定边界。 输入是被称为偏好式 RL、半监督 RL 或 RLHF 的文献。综述把 RLHF 定义为从间接人工反馈学习奖励或策略，而不是直接手写标量奖励，产出覆盖控制与语言模型的纳入范围。若示范或离线初始化不属于主要反馈循环，就应单独处理。
  1. 分类反馈采集。 输入是查询、行为样本、标注者和交互界面。按照人类观察什么、返回什么，组织示范、干预、纠正、比较、排序、评分、批评和语言反馈，产出反馈记录 taxonomy。检查标注人群、查询策略、粒度、噪声和成本。
  1. 分类奖励学习。 输入是反馈记录。比较偏好模型、reward function、贝叶斯与集成处理、主动查询选择以及不确定性处理，产出学习信号及其假设。检查留出偏好预测、校准、可识别性和分布偏移。
  1. 分类策略学习。 输入是学习到的奖励或直接偏好信号，以及策略 rollout。整理在线或离线 RL、正则化、基于模型的方法和 LLM 专用目标，产出优化策略。必须把奖励拟合与策略行为分开，并测试 reward hacking 或过度优化。
  1. 路由证据与风险。 输入是应用、benchmark、数据集和已报告失败。把每项主张映射回反馈、奖励、策略和评测对象，产出可复用的审计清单与开放问题地图。具体实现仍需回到被引主来源核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Taxonomy coverage. The paper systematically links feedback forms, query selection, reward estimation, policy optimization, applications, evaluation, and datasets, with a dedicated LLM appendix and deeper control/robotics treatment. This is evidence that the decomposition is broad enough to route primary work, not evidence that one RLHF algorithm wins.

Cross-stage failure analysis. Its synthesis repeatedly distinguishes preference-label quality, reward-model generalization, and optimized-policy behavior, and catalogs risks such as annotator inconsistency, distribution shift, reward exploitation, and evaluation dependence. This supports the survey's audit value; every numerical or implementation claim still belongs to the cited experiment.

taxonomy 覆盖。 论文系统连接反馈形式、查询选择、奖励估计、策略优化、应用、评测和数据集，并设置 LLM 专用附录，对控制与机器人提供更深入梳理。这说明该分解足以路由主论文，并不能证明某一种 RLHF 算法获胜。

跨阶段失败分析。 综述反复区分偏好标签质量、reward model 泛化和优化后策略行为，并整理标注者不一致、分布偏移、奖励利用和评测依赖等风险。这支持它作为审计框架的价值；任何数值或实现结论仍属于被引实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Wirth et al.'s 2017 preference-based RL survey and recent LLM alignment surveys are the closest predecessors. This work connects those traditions and organizes RLHF by the lifecycle of feedback, reward, and policy rather than by application alone. It does not introduce a new learner or dataset; the new value is a common vocabulary that reveals where data quality and statistical assumptions enter. The cross-domain view also prevents LLM practice from being treated as the whole history of human-feedback learning.
最接近的前作是 Wirth 等人在 2017 年发表的偏好式 RL 综述，以及近年的 LLM 对齐综述。这项工作连接两条传统，并按照反馈、奖励和策略的生命周期组织 RLHF，而不是只按应用分类。它没有提出新学习器或数据集；新增价值是建立共同词汇，揭示数据质量和统计假设在哪个环节进入系统。跨领域视角也避免把 LLM 实践误当成人工反馈学习的全部历史。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Uneven scope. Control and robotics receive the deepest treatment, while the LLM literature moves quickly; check newer primary work before treating the taxonomy as exhaustive.
  • Survey evidence. The synthesis cannot verify every cited dataset, annotator pool, reward model, or implementation; trace any deployment claim to the original artifact and evaluation.
  • Feedback ambiguity. Human preference can encode correctness, style, safety, or annotator-specific values; record the target construct before reusing a method for reasoning supervision.

• 范围不均衡。 论文对控制与机器人最深入，而 LLM 文献变化很快；不能把 taxonomy 当成穷尽列表，使用前要检查更新的主论文。
  • 综述证据边界。 综合分析无法验证每个被引数据集、标注人群、reward model 或实现；任何部署主张都应追溯到原始工件与评测。
  • 反馈语义含混。 人类偏好可能编码正确性、风格、安全或特定标注者价值；把方法用于推理监督前必须明确目标构念。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this survey before designing or reviewing an RLHF system. Supply the proposed queries, annotators, feedback format, reward learner, policy objective, and evaluation; map each item to the survey's stages and output an audit table of assumptions, missing evidence, and failure checks. Success means a statement such as “RLHF improved the model” can be rewritten as stage-specific, testable claims. Do not use the survey in place of dataset documentation, annotation instructions, or the primary algorithm paper.
设计或评审 RLHF 系统前，可以先使用这篇综述。输入计划采用的查询、标注者、反馈形式、奖励学习器、策略目标和评测，把每项映射到综述阶段，输出包含假设、缺失证据和失败检查的审计表。成功标准是能把“RLHF 提升了模型”改写成针对具体阶段、可以检验的主张。它不能替代数据集文档、标注说明或算法主论文。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep: RLHF is a chain of feedback acquisition, reward learning, and policy learning, not one homogeneous operation.
  2. Route first: identify the feedback record and its human/AI source before comparing algorithms.
  3. Separate: reward-model fit, policy behavior, and held-out evaluation require different evidence.
  4. Do not infer: a human preference label automatically measures correctness or shared human values.
  5. Audit first: annotator population, query policy, reward version, optimization objective, shift, and exploitation risk.

1. 应记住： RLHF 是反馈采集、奖励学习和策略学习组成的链条，而不是一个同质操作。
  2. 先做路由： 比较算法前，先确认反馈记录是什么，以及来自人还是 AI。
  3. 必须分开： reward model 拟合、策略行为和留出评测需要不同证据。
  4. 不能推出： 人类偏好标签不自动等于正确性或全体人类共同价值。
  5. 扩展前审计： 标注人群、查询策略、奖励版本、优化目标、分布偏移和奖励利用风险。
